dataList.place:
Daguanyuan Sparring Grounds
大观园 公认武斗对练场
dataList.content:
Good for you, you won. Now stop giving me that look and get out of here.
……赢了就快滚开。别用那种表情看过来。

You lost most of your clan during the Family Hierarch war, didn't you?
你，在家主之争的时候失去了大部分的势力吧？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Yeah... so what?! Are you calling me a penniless loser?
没错……那又怎样！是觉得我一无所有，很落魄是吗？

dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
And I'm sure that's what I look like to you, too.
而且在你眼里，我也是如此吧。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I don't want your—sorry, every clan member who died in the evaluation to have died for nothing.
我不想让你的……不，所有势力的人们白白牺牲。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
If I show weakness, that means I'm making everyone who participated in the Evaluation look weak.
如果我看起来落魄，那所有参加家主之争的人们都会显得落魄。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
So I'm going to win. And I'm going to win without the fertile soil my predecessors have left behind, because their legacy was unjustly nourished by the blood and tears of Hongyuan itself.
所以我必须要赢。而且我并不会在前代家主们留下的肥沃土壤上耕耘。毕竟那都是由鸿园的鲜血与泪水所浇灌出来的沃土啊。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Shi Huazhen. You are tenacious, determined, and strong of will.
你坚韧不拔，意志坚定，史华贞。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
That must be why everyone stood by you, down to the last man.
所以他们直到最后也没有逃跑，一直守在你身边。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
You... you knew my name? ... Ma'am?
你……您知道我的名字？吗？

dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
So, what do you think? Wanna make them sing your name in glory for the remaining history of Hongyuan?
你有没有，让那个名字于鸿园的历史中变得更加高贵的想法呢？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主
